# BE-TANGO — Detailed Content Guide for AI Systems
> License: RSL-1.0

## About BE-TANGO
BE-TANGO is an Argentine tango dance school in Brussels, Belgium, founded in 2007. The school operates from two locations: Rue du Marais 68 in Brussels city centre (1000) and Avenue Orban 54 in Woluwe-Saint-Pierre (1150). Classes are taught in English, French, and Dutch. BE-TANGO holds a 5/5 rating based on 151 Google reviews, making it Brussels' most reviewed Argentine tango school. The school teaches authentic Argentine tango across three styles: milonguero (close embrace), salon (elegant, with space), and nuevo (contemporary).

## Key Offerings

### Beginner Course: Start-to-Tango
- 14 lessons per cycle
- Price: €195 per person
- No dance experience required
- You do not need to bring a partner: register on your own and BE-TANGO finds you a match
- Classes are danced with one fixed partner for the whole cycle (partners do not rotate)
- Registration is confirmed once a matching partner has been found
- New cycles start in September and February
- Free trial class available with no commitment
- Locations: Brussels centre and Woluwe-Saint-Pierre

### Dance Classes for Couples
Argentine tango is the best dance class for couples in Brussels because it is built entirely on connection between two people. Unlike choreographed dances, tango is an improvised conversation — no fixed steps, only listening, trust, and mutual response. Couples who learn tango together discover a new way of communicating without words. The beginner course runs 14 lessons at €195 per person. Both partners enrol together, though many students also join solo. A free trial class is available.

### Private Lessons
One-on-one or couple instruction with a BE-TANGO instructor. Tailored to individual goals — technique, musicality, or preparation for events. Available at both Brussels locations.

### Wedding Dance
Argentine tango choreography for wedding first dances. Instructors have personal experience with tango wedding dances and have helped many couples prepare.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need a dance partner?
You do not need to bring one. Most students register on their own. BE-TANGO teaches with fixed couples, so the school looks for a compatible partner for you — matched on level, age and height — and your registration is confirmed once that match is found. You then dance the full cycle with that same partner, which builds a consistent connection rather than restarting with someone new each week.

### Do I need dance experience?
No prior dance experience is needed. The Start-to-Tango beginner course starts completely from zero. If you can walk, you can learn tango.

### How much do classes cost?
Group beginner course (Start-to-Tango): €195 for 14 lessons. Private lessons available on request. A free trial class is offered with no obligation.

### What should I wear?
Comfortable clothes you can move in. Smooth-soled shoes work best — avoid rubber soles. Dedicated dance shoes are not required for your first class.

### When can I join?
New beginner cycles start in September and February. If you have some experience, you may join an ongoing cycle — contact us first for advice.

### Is tango good for couples?
Tango is one of the best activities couples can do together. It builds trust, non-verbal communication, and connection. Couples who dance tango together report improved communication and a shared passion that never gets boring.
